lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are arranged in approximately four horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, with the central two rows showing the most consistent spatial equidistance.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a discernible grid-like lattice across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and a shadow-induced lower luminance on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 15-20 high-luminance blobs of varying diameters are distributed within the first dorsal fin macro-mask, with a higher spatial density observed in the anterior-basal region of the fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The trailing edge of the first dorsal fin exhibits minor jagged irregularities and small notches; several reddish-brown punctate features are visible scattered across the lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: The large pectoral fin in the foreground displays a high-contrast pattern of white circular blobs, with the highest density concentrated along its leading edge.
